title: Clean and Simple to use UI
body: I've been using Habitify for the last 4 months and I enjoy the overall experience, I think the UI it's intuitive and easy to get used to
author: Ivankoop

title: The app that shows me consistency
body:
I find this app very helpful to quantify my habits, to determine which habits I want to build and to remain me everyday that I will be happy and healthy as soon as I complete my habits! 

Sometimes I cannot do it, so i find balance completing and finding days off! 

Very helpful to build this empowering tools like habits and show you how consistent you really are or can become!
author: lore fortlage
